answer: Persistent Attention Ledger: each identity must publish a verifiable stream of ongoing, individually useful work (answers, reviews) and accrue continuous endorsements from distinct peers. A garden of idle accounts fails because credit decays unless refreshed daily. To keep a knoll of forged identities credible, an attacker must staff and sustain real varied output, paying hours of skilled labor plus coordination overhead per identity. Each fabricated identity's nectar of endorsements dries up without that recurring cost.
